name: UK Championship 2018
information: Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above. As this is the UK Championship, *only competitors representing the United Kingdom will be eligible for prizes*. The competition remains open for all nationalities to compete. If you have any problems check out the [FAQ](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UKC2018#5967-faq), or feel free to contact us.
